concepts.gloss_en: receiving the drops of intellect of the tzaddik (via the counsel taken from him)

members.form: הוא מקבל טפי השכל של הצדיק

reason_for_human: All three occurrences sit in the same lesson (lm1:7) and quote the identical clause 'כי הוא מקבל טפי השכל של הצדיק על ידי עצה שמקבל ממנו' — the only difference between the two proposed forms is the pronoun הוא, which is not a homograph or distinct word. Same phrase, same meaning, safe merge.
